purpose: Action System contract for real-model server runs; local core remains orchestration and audit storage.

decision_policy.input: Observation JSON plus eligible feedback and trace references
decision_policy.output: One JSON object containing proposal (action_type, arguments, expected_versions, estimated_cost, rationale) and an optional bounded reflection
react_constraints: no hidden chain-of-thought in the audit record
reflexion_constraints: reflection becomes eligible from the next batch
reflection tokens and calls use the shared decision budget
no persistent code, Prompt, Skill, or Memory-rule edit

task_model_trainer.input: Training records, parent checkpoint, pinned recipe, seed

evaluator.input: Checkpoint path, split name, evaluator revision

invariants: held_in is the only candidate-selection split
held_out is regression-report-only before final freeze
final_test remains locked until all candidate decisions finish
candidate branches do not share newly created checkpoints or memory
failed candidates cannot mutate the active harness
all calls, tokens, training steps, evaluator calls and feedback requests count toward budget
every output contains dataset, harness, code, model and checkpoint provenance
